title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2607.21556v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) removes the external teacher required by on-policy distillation (OPD), but still needs asymmetric information between teacher and student so that the self-teacher provides a stronger learning signal. Existing methods create this asymmetry through privileged answers or visual evidence. We ask whether both can be removed, yielding a simpler form of OPSD driven purely by input conditioning. We propose Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation, namely VCSD, which converts image-content removal into an on-policy self-distillation signal. At each student-generated response prefix, the EMA teacher produces two next-token distributions under the same prompt and prefix: one conditioned on the original image and the other on a content-erased control. translated_abstract: 在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）移除了在策略蒸馏（OPD）所需的外部教师模型，但仍需要教师与学生之间的信息不对称，以便自教师能够提供更强的学习信号。现有方法通过特权答案或视觉证据来创造这种不对称性。我们探讨能否将两者同时去除，从而得到一种纯粹由输入条件驱动的更简单的OPSD形式。我们提出了视觉对比自蒸馏（VCSD），它将图像内容移除转化为一种在策略自蒸馏信号。在学生生成的每个回答前缀处，EMA教师模型在相同提示和前缀条件下产生两个下一词元分布：一个以原始图像为条件，另一个以内容擦除后的对照图像为条件。两者的逐词元对数概率差异能够凸显出那些其似然因实例级视觉内容而特异性提升的候选词元。我们利用这种……
tldr: 提出视觉对比自蒸馏（VCSD），通过对比原始图像与内容擦除图像下EMA教师模型的下一词元分布差异，将图像内容移除转化为在策略自蒸馏信号，无需特权答案或视觉证据即可实现纯输入条件驱动的自蒸馏。
en_tdlr: Proposes Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation (VCSD), which converts image-content removal into an on-policy self-distillation signal by contrasting the EMA teacher's next-token distributions conditioned on the original versus content-erased image, enabling purely input-conditioned self-distillation without requiring privileged answers or visual evidence.
